speaker: john_heminges
text: On Saturday night, at the door, I had Friday as the Shrew and Saturday as Two Gentlemen. The leaf has the two days the other way.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Say the leaf, then. I will not play a memory against a paper.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Today is Two Gentlemen. You are in it. Tomorrow is the Shrew. You are in it. I am not giving you a part's name the leaf has not required me to say.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The leaf. Two of the clock. I am not rehearsing a title we have already played this year.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I play what the leaf says. No new name for me in either.

speaker: john_heminges
text: No new name. Get into the gown you already know.
